title: AUTONOMOUS_WORK and CAPABILITY_CATALOG_AND_DISCOVERY both claim package intergrax/autonomous_work (ambiguous semantic owner)
affected_invariant: single semantic owner per domain (roadmap section 1)
evidence: E1:A4 package_map owner_doc of intergrax/autonomous_work is CAPABILITY_CATALOG_AND_DISCOVERY.md; both A8 input rows list the package
impact: The 72-file package mixes capability discovery/acquisition adapters with worker goal evaluation/recovery modules; no document states which doc owns which module group.
recommendation: Add a module-to-doc ownership table in one of the two docs.

title: AUTONOMOUS_WORK architecture doc maturity frozen at AW-0 while AW-7C is CLOSED and the package has 72 modules
affected_invariant: doc status consistent with roadmap closure
impact: A reader cannot tell which parts (capability recovery AW-7A..7C) are implemented versus the not-implemented Virtual Worker lifecycle; FRZ BND-03, CTR-04, RPL, SEC-05..07 links are OPEN.
recommendation: Update the claim/maturity boundary to the current AW stage and list the implemented slice explicitly.

title: ENTERPRISE_RELIABILITY_LAYER: plan pair missing by filename, and the doc says NOT STARTED while a 29-file runtime package exists
affected_invariant: canonical arch/plan pair; doc status truthful
impact: The doc (L278-279) says no 1:1 plan pair and implementation not started; the plan file exists under another name and declares itself the 1:1 pair; the same doc (L270) describes registry/gateway as shipped and the package has admission, compensation and gateway modules. The pair detector flags a missing plan and the maturity claim is unreliable.
recommendation: Rename or relink the plan as the canonical pair and restate maturity (implemented slice vs target).

title: COMPAT_X feature has no plan pair and is not registered in capabilities/README.md
evidence: E1:grep of capabilities/README.md finds no COMPAT row (and no EVOL_X row; EVOL_X is outside this batch, noted for the parent)
impact: A closed stage with 8 PASS FRZ-CMP rows has an architecture policy doc but no delivery plan and no hub registration; discoverability and the pair rule are not met.
recommendation: Add a plan doc (or an explicit exemption line) and register the feature in the hub.

title: PROOF_RECEIPTS has no lifecycle/retention, failure/recovery or tenant/security rules
affected_invariant: tenant isolation / secret handling for evidence records
impact: Receipts are partitioned by application_id only; nothing states tenant scoping, retention, or recovery of a failed receipt write beyond fail-no-fallback for live proofs. Related to the A4 evidence-plane owner concern (EQOA-A4-*).
recommendation: State tenant/retention/failure ownership or declare the proof store out of tenant scope.

title: Domain docs claim implementation/qualification maturity without a roadmap stage or FRZ link (uncertified self-claims)
impact: AHI (A4/I3/P2/E2), DECISION_SYSTEM (E1 evidence axis), PLATFORM_PLUGINS (closed program), COLLABORATIVE_WORK (MP-1 closed) and others carry self-declared maturity or closure, but no roadmap stage or FRZ row in A1/A3 names them (roadmap greps: AHI 0, DECISION_SYSTEM 0, PLATFORM_PLUGINS 0, PROOF_RECEIPTS 0, CAPABILITY_CATALOG 0, COLLABORATIVE_WORK 0). Status is therefore IMPLEMENTED_UNCERTIFIED in A8.
recommendation: Operator decides whether these domains need a stage/FRZ mapping before ARCH-FREEZE or are outside its scope.

title: Domains whose packages are outside the A4 concern list (DOCUMENTED_DOMAIN_OUTSIDE_CONCERN_LIST)
evidence: E1:A4 classification of intergrax/runtime/adaptive, cli, scaffold, harness, autonomous_work, collaborative_work
impact: These domains have owner docs but no A4 concern (empty concerns in the A8 input), so their packages are not covered by concern-level evidence. Reference only; the A4 owner-doc findings are already filed.
recommendation: Add concerns or document them as satellite domains.

title: Domains without a failure/recovery owner or observability owner section
impact: No section assigns who recovers a failed experiment/replay, Tier-3 assembly failure, or collaborative write; sampled by heading and keyword only, so absence is not proof of a code gap.
recommendation: Owners confirm cross-reference to the Reliability owner or add a short recovery paragraph.

title: PLATFORM_PLUGINS closure claim vs FRZ-PLG-01..08 OPEN
impact: The domain doc states the plugin roadmap is PRODUCTION-GRADE - ROADMAP COMPLETE while the freeze checklist keeps all eight FRZ-PLG rows OPEN; scopes differ (domain program vs freeze criteria), but readers may take the closure as freeze acceptance. FRZ checklist decides criterion status.
recommendation: Qualify the closure sentence as domain-program closure, not freeze acceptance.

title: ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE declared exceptions: runtime dormant in shipped hosts, retention not enforced, tenant-wide capabilities
impact: Library-only retention/TTL, no AUDIT_EVIDENCE producer, raw storage tools not tenant-scoped, tenant-wide capabilities and open hardening debt are declared by the doc itself. PDC-D8 is in flight: no closure assumed. The doc status line (draft PR, not merged) is stale because the code is at the baseline SHA, and the plan still lists hub registration as open although capabilities/README.md L79 registers it.
recommendation: Track reopen conditions in PDC-X; refresh the status line.
